metadata.title: Clicked like a confused squirrel and somehow got 2 unlucky souls? Valorant aim is a glitch
metadata.description:
Me: flailing like my mouse has a vendetta
Enemy: probably questioning their entire existence
How did that even hit twice? No clue but I’m cashing in
If your aim’s a glorious mess, welcome to the chaos

Tap if your aim cheats like mine!
